direction: Modify the method to include a context subgraph selection heuristic based on entity centrality and relation specificity to reduce noise and improve the signal‑to‑noise ratio of triple‑level enrichment.
hypothesis: Training language models with enriched context subgraphs selected by entity centrality and relation specificity, combined with an adaptive repair loop and RL optimization, will improve multi‑hop QA performance (Hits@1) on longer reasoning chains compared to training on isolated triples or using full‑passage context.
rationale: Existing work (e.g., UniKGQA, MRE) enriches reasoning with subgraphs or trajectories but does not select context triples based on entity centrality and relation specificity. This modification addresses the noise risk identified in gap G001 while preserving the novelty of context subgraph enrichment and adaptive repair loop.
